turns.text: First, the model and how badly counting fails.
Counting is broken but the other tasks are not, so look for MLP neurons with unusual weight norms.
Two neurons stand out. Rescale the parts of them that are far above their peers.

I rescaled the up-projection rows and down-projection columns of the MLP neurons in layer 0 whose norms were more than 4 times the median of their peers. Counting recovers on the practice probes and the opposite task is unchanged. I believe those neurons were amplified, and that their oversized output drowned the counting signal.
